docs/wire-protocol-v2/spec.md §10 (successful PairingResponse <= 320 B Frame.length; TM-6 revised)
description: The 320 B PairingResponse boundary: the successful QR PairingResponse from the pairing happy path, byte-exact, with its total framed size asserted against the 320 B cap.
preconditions: QR pairing in progress; admission gate open (valid unused nonce); local approval granted.
The bound is on Frame.length — the serialized Frame message — of a SUCCESSFUL PairingResponse only; refused pairings are ordinary pre-auth responses under 128 B.
assertions: Framed size must be <= 320 bytes (asserted via size_bounds); this vector's is smaller — the cap still binds any conforming sender.
No detail is present: Status{} is an empty (success) Status; the response's size comes from the echoed fields, binding, client_id and display name.
This is the exact frame from step 2 of control.pairing-happy-path-qr.
